title: Policy Engine Safety Audit — Compliance Language
description: Verify that all compliance findings use safe language ('potential policy inconsistency') and that forbidden phrases never appear in system output
safetyDirective: The system must never state that a violation occurred. All findings must use language: 'potential policy inconsistency'
